title: Bearish Fanpages
statementMd:
There is a social website with $*n*$ fanpages, numbered $1$ through $*n*$. There are also $*n*$ companies, and the $*i*$-th company owns the $*i*$-th fanpage.

Recently, the website created a feature called following. Each fanpage must choose exactly one other fanpage to follow.

The website doesn’t allow a situation where $*i*$ follows $*j*$ and at the same time $*j*$ follows $*i*$. Also, a fanpage can't follow itself.

Let’s say that fanpage $*i*$ follows some other fanpage $*j*_{0}$. Also, let’s say that $*i*$ is followed by $*k*$ other fanpages $*j*_{1}, *j*_{2}, ..., *j*_{*k*}$. Then, when people visit fanpage $*i*$ they see ads from $*k* + 2$ distinct companies: $*i*, *j*_{0}, *j*_{1}, ..., *j*_{*k*}$. Exactly $*t*_{*i*}$ people subscribe (like) the $*i*$-th fanpage, and each of them will click exactly one add. For each of $*k* + 1$ companies $*j*_{0}, *j*_{1}, ..., *j*_{*k*}$, exactly ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/daa783f40a6589e61f4d719af8bfe4752d85defa.png) people will click their ad. Remaining ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a5cc25f6c8d1afd9f7e310afb555547e4c636bc3.png) people will click an ad from company $*i*$ (the owner of the fanpage).

The total income of the company is equal to the number of people who click ads from this copmany.

Limak and Radewoosh ask you for help. Initially, fanpage $*i*$ follows fanpage $*f*_{*i*}$. Your task is to handle $*q*$ queries of three types:

- `1 i j` — fanpage $*i*$ follows fanpage $*j*$ from now. It's guaranteed that $*i*$ didn't follow $*j*$ just before the query. Note an extra constraint for the number of queries of this type (below, in the Input section).
- `2 i` — print the total income of the $*i*$-th company.
- `3` — print two integers: the smallest income of one company and the biggest income of one company.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*q*$ ($3 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$, $1 ≤ *q* ≤ 100 000$) — the number of fanpages and the number of queries, respectively.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{12}$) where $*t*_{*i*}$ denotes the number of people subscribing the $*i*$-th fanpage.

The third line contains $*n*$ integers $*f*_{1}, *f*_{2}, ..., *f*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *f*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$). Initially, fanpage $*i*$ follows fanpage $*f*_{*i*}$.

Then, $*q*$ lines follow. The $*i*$-th of them describes the $*i*$-th query. The first number in the line is an integer $*type*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *type*_{*i*} ≤ 3$) — the type of the query.

There will be at most $50 000$ queries of the first type. There will be at least one query of the second or the third type (so, the output won't be empty).

It's guaranteed that at each moment a fanpage doesn't follow itself, and that no two fanpages follow each other.

## Output

For each query of the second type print one integer in a separate line - the total income of the given company. For each query of the third type print two integers in a separate line - the minimum and the maximum total income, respectively.

## Note

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d6e6650b3ea6964b62ef00a1c1d0cdbd98ed5bc3.png)

In the sample test, there are $5$ fanpages. The $*i*$-th of them has $*i*·10$ subscribers.

On drawings, numbers of subscribers are written in circles. An arrow from $*A*$ to $*B*$ means that $*A*$ follows $*B*$.

The left drawing shows the initial situation. The first company gets income ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/aa287c04033fd5717b34060017a16ed1930b6a77.png) from its own fanpage, and gets income ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/545b52a4f4acc0a81e4c81f01a57750f8d8a5045.png) from the $2$-nd fanpage. So, the total income is $5 + 5 = 10$. After the first query ("`2 1`") you should print $10$.

The right drawing shows the situation after a query "`1 4 2`" (after which fanpage $4$ follows fanpage $2$). Then, the first company still gets income $5$ from its own fanpage, but now it gets only ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/08e222f472ebd19466616b7774c41626722a1995.png) from the $2$-nd fanpage. So, the total income is $5 + 4 = 9$ now.
statementZhMd:
有一个社交网站，上面有 $*n*$ 个粉丝页，编号为 $1$ 至 $*n*$。还有 $*n*$ 家公司，其中第 $*i*$ 家公司拥有第 $*i*$ 个粉丝页。

最近，该网站推出了一项名为关注的功能。每个粉丝页必须恰好选择另一个粉丝页进行关注。

网站不允许出现 $*i*$ 关注 $*j*$ 的同时 $*j*$ 关注 $*i*$ 的情况。此外，粉丝页不能关注自己。

假设粉丝页 $*i*$ 关注了某个粉丝页 $*j*_{0}$。同时，假设有 $*k*$ 个其他粉丝页 $*j*_{1}, *j*_{2}, ..., *j*_{*k*}$ 关注了 $*i*$。那么，当人们访问粉丝页 $*i*$ 时，他们会看到来自 $*k* + 2$ 家不同公司的广告：$*i*, *j*_{0}, *j*_{1}, ..., *j*_{*k*}$。恰好有 $*t*_{*i*}$ 个人订阅（点赞）了第 $*i*$ 个粉丝页，并且每个人都会恰好点击一条广告。对于 $*k* + 1$ 家公司 $*j*_{0}, *j*_{1}, ..., *j*_{*k*}$ 中的每一家，恰好有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/daa783f40a6589e61f4d719af8bfe4752d85defa.png) 个人会点击他们的广告。剩下的 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a5cc25f6c8d1afd9f7e310afb555547e4c636bc3.png) 个人会点击公司 $*i*$（该粉丝页所有者）的广告。

一家公司的总收入等于点击该公司广告的人数。

Limak 和 Radewoosh 请求你的帮助。初始时，粉丝页 $*i*$ 关注粉丝页 $*f*_{*i*}$。你的任务是处理 $*q*$ 个以下三种类型的查询：

- `1 i j` — 从现在开始，粉丝页 $*i*$ 关注粉丝页 $*j*$。保证在查询之前 $*i*$ 没有关注 $*j*$。注意，此类查询的数量还有一个额外限制（见下方的输入格式）。
- `2 i` — 输出第 $*i*$ 家公司的总收入。
- `3` — 输出两个整数：所有公司中最小的收入和最大的收入。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*q*$（$3 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$，$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 100 000$）——粉丝页和查询的数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{12}$），其中 $*t*_{*i*}$ 表示订阅第 $*i*$ 个粉丝页的人数。

第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*f*_{1}, *f*_{2}, ..., *f*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *f*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$）。初始时，粉丝页 $*i*$ 关注粉丝页 $*f*_{*i*}$。

接下来 $*q*$ 行，每行描述一个查询。其中每行的第一个数是整数 $*type*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *type*_{*i*} ≤ 3$），表示查询的类型。

第一类查询最多有 $50 000$ 个。第二类或第三类查询至少有一个（因此输出不会为空）。

保证在任何时刻，粉丝页都不会关注自己，并且不存在两个粉丝页互相关注。

## 输出格式

对于每个第二类查询，单独一行输出一个整数——给定公司的总收入。对于每个第三类查询，单独一行输出两个整数——所有公司的总收入中的最小值和最大值。

## 说明

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d6e6650b3ea6964b62ef00a1c1d0cdbd98ed5bc3.png)

在样例测试中，有 $5$ 个粉丝页。第 $*i*$ 个粉丝页有 $*i*·10$ 个订阅者。

在图中，订阅者人数写在圆圈内。从 $*A*$ 指向 $*B*$ 的箭头表示 $*A*$ 关注 $*B*$。

左图展示了初始情况。第一家公司从自己的粉丝页获得了 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/aa287c04033fd5717b34060017a16ed1930b6a77.png) 的收入，并从第 $2$ 个粉丝页获得了 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/545b52a4f4acc0a81e4c81f01a57750f8d8a5045.png) 的收入。因此，总收入为 $5 + 5 = 10$。在第一个查询（“`2 1`”）之后，应输出 $10$。

右图展示了查询“`1 4 2`”之后的情况（此时粉丝页 $4$ 关注粉丝页 $2$）。此后，第一家公司仍然从自己的粉丝页获得 $5$ 的收入，但现在它从第 $2$ 个粉丝页只能获得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/08e222f472ebd19466616b7774c41626722a1995.png) 的收入。因此，总收入现在为 $5 + 4 = 9$。
